gbm.note: raw[k] = baseline[k] + sum over iterations of trees[i][k](x); probs = softmax(raw). At an inner node (f >= 0): x[f] NaN -> left if m else right; x[f] <= t -> left.

hazard.design: [ln(my_clock+0.05), my_clock<1, my_clock<2, my_clock<4, ln(opp_clock+0.05), inc_s, base_s/60, ent, ply/100]; ent = entropy of the final move distribution

meta.fit_on: bullet train + val, all controls (test never used)

move_sampling.order: sample the move first from the final distribution, then the think time given that move
move_sampling.book: p = w*book/n + (1-w)*model, w = n/(n+0.25), n = recency-weighted (half-life 21 d) count over legal moves, only for ply < 20 and n >= 0.02
move_sampling.infinity: 1e+300 stands for +infinity in edges and tree thresholds
